text_block_list.name: Voice on the TV
text_block_list.text:
『――And this concludes this week's highlights from 
the Twinkle Series！ Man～ yet another set of noteworthy 
races to keep adding to the list！』
――『I still think it has to be you』
――『I still think it has to be you』

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
……So it's finally happened, huh？ 
Heh…… Guess I need to be careful what I say.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oops！ I need to get going.

Even though she rejected me when I scouted her, I couldn't get 
the sight of her running out of my head―― While thinking that, 
before I knew it I was back at that Soba stand.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh！？ Well what do you know, if it ain't the Trainer from before！

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Hehehe, ain't you lucky!? 
Big festival goin' on right here today!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Can't leave without checkin' it out, right!? 
It's festival time, gotta show face!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wasshoi! Wasshoi!! C'mon, keep it comin'! 
Let's kick this up a notch!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You too, let's hear ya shout! 
Wasshoi! Wasshoi!!
(Pop pop pop!!)

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Gwah~ naturally, Inari-chan...! Ya got me! 
Damn it, take it, ya little thief!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahaha! How's that, got your payback! 
Alright, which stall next!?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Man, no match for Inari-chan! 
...Oh right, kid from takeout place 
opened stall for first time.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Got good batch of pickling cucumbers, 
go check it later! Kid'll be thrilled if 
Inari-chan shows up.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Bet! Planned on it from start. 
I'll buy 5, maybe 10, start off strong!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper Old Man
text_block_list.text: Just as expected from Inari-chan! Pure class!!

text_block_list.name: Purple Scrunchie Uma Musume
text_block_list.text:
Inari-neecha~n!! Over here, over here!! 
Whole team just gathered up too~!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really!? Whole team, 
that means... Chief! Good seein' ya.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
Good work. ...Hm? Person behind you... 
that collar badge, are they maybe...

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
Good work. ...Hm? Person behind you... 
that collar badge, are they maybe...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't look so spooked! Won't bite 
yer head off. Scary face sure, but nice guy deep down!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
Inari, always run yer mouth. 
...Apologies. Heard you came all way from 
Tracen Academy just to see this girl.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hear that, Chief!? You trained me up this good, 
ain't ya proud!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is my turf. Winnin' tons on Chief's team, 
I'll make massive waves right here in Oi!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gotta come Oi racetrack 
to see me run, right? Right!?

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief. Hopeless as ever.

Near end, festival hit peak frenzy, 
so we ducked into temple grounds to escape noise.

Glanced sideways as Inari One chomped grilled carrot, 
finished last gulp of ramune. ...Then broke silence.
choice_data_list: You really love it here, don't you？
You really love it here, don't you？

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ! ...Well, yeah, 'course.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Way I am—classy 
Edo kid fightin' for hometown, all thanks 
to folks in this town.
choice_data_list: The team has a good atmosphere too

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
See? Got good eye after all— 
...Hey, cut that out.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Quit givin' me those puppy dog eyes. Geez...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wanna see my run that bad!? Fine, just for you, 
show ya my legs right now!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Eh... really wanna see it that much!? 
Man, people like you...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Edo kid never backs down on word. 
No help for it, follow me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, around here works. 
Alright then—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Keep eyes peeled! ...Haaa!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oraoraoraoraoraoraaaa!!

Even on gravel path, Inari One tore ahead with 
unshakable power. Blazing through dark, 
mighty stride sight to behold—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Whew~!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Piece of cake! Nothin' to it.
choice_data_list: As I thought, your run is the best！
As I thought, your run is the best！

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (...Aah, damn. Staring with such dead-honest eyes, this guy.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (What am I supposed to do with this—)
